_Original comment by_ **Andres Riancho (BitBucket: [andresriancho](http://bitbucket.org/andresriancho), GitHub: @andresriancho?)**:

I'm also getting the "No such message id E1122" error, this is the traceback:

```
#!python
ERROR: test_pylint_core_controllers (w3af.core.controllers.tests.test_pylint.PylintRunner)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/ubuntu/w3af/w3af/core/controllers/tests/test_pylint.py", line 74, in test_pylint_core_controllers
    pylint_output = self.run_pylint('%s/core/controllers/' % ROOT_PATH)
  File "/home/ubuntu/w3af/w3af/core/controllers/tests/test_pylint.py", line 65, in run_pylint
    lint.Run(pylint_args, reporter=TextReporter(pylint_output), exit=False)
  File "/home/ubuntu/w3af/venv/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/lint.py", line 983, in __init__
    linter.load_config_file()
  File "/home/ubuntu/w3af/venv/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/logilab/common/configuration.py", line 662, in load_config_file
    provider.set_option(option, value, optdict=optdict)
  File "/home/ubuntu/w3af/venv/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/lint.py", line 383, in set_option
    meth(_id)
  File "/home/ubuntu/w3af/venv/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/utils.py", line 288, in enable
    msg = self.check_message_id(msgid)
  File "/home/ubuntu/w3af/venv/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/utils.py", line 315, in check_message_id
    raise UnknownMessage('No such message id %s' % msgid)
UnknownMessage: No such message id E1122
```

I've got:
- logilab-astng==0.24.3
- pylint==1.0.0

Should I "pip install" something different? Maybe from this repository? Is there any release which includes this fix?
